title: hotel/school connected to mall/cinema/airport with killer
content: weirdest dream I’ve had and not many of my dreams I remember/end very vividly but I remember loads about this just had a dream I was in a house party, the whole of a community I’m part of was invited (don’t remember which community). It was a house party but the party wasn’t at a house it was at a uni/school type location which in the end looked like my old high school, there was this lad I knew that got invited (can’t remember who) and he won a prize at the party and it was a knife ?? so like midway through the dream I was on the plane twice at this airport (recurring because I’ve been on this plane before in a dream but never been on a plane once in real life) I went somewhere on it then had to go back bc I was missing something?? Idk so anyway I’m back at this party and it’s turned into a massive shopping centre with a cinema and loads of dorms so it’s like a uni cross with cinema cross shopping centre and everyone’s drunk and we won these free drink tickets everyone did so we’re going to the mall bit where people buy food and drink and asking for bare alcohol then anyway fast forward to the end of the night we’re all drunk & this guy who won the knifes going around lit killing everyone like random people and we were all shook, I was hiding in the dorm room with bare people but everyone started killing eachother in the end to protect themselves like they dunno who the killer is & I run out the room and some guy was holding a knife near me So I run into the hallway and someone I know was there but I didn’t know him in my dream like we’d only just met? But I stayed with him and he was tryna get us out of there protecting us from the killers & we got out on the street somehow but it ended by escaping on the plane
